en.explanation:
Let be the charge density of the spherical charge distribution of radius r1 centred at the origin O. A spherical cavity of radius r2 centred at P with distance OP = a = r1 r2 is made in the spherical charge distribution.

The sphere with cavity is equivalent to a sphere of uniform charge density and radius r2 centred at P embedded in the original sphere. Thus, the electric field at a point Q in the cavity is superposition of (i) electric field at Q due to the sphere of charge density and radius r1 centred at O (say 1), and (ii) electric field at Q due to the sphere of charge density and radius r2 centred at P (say 2). Let , , and be the vectors as shown in the figure. The electric fields 1, 2, and their superposition 12 are given by
